subject: Edge finishing and assembly quality
hook: Trade edge banding and cabinet assembly in Stoke-on-Trent.
gbp:
Kitchen fitters, joiners, shopfitters and small furniture makers: SUPERIO offers trade workshop services from our own workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent.

If you'd rather spend your time fitting than edging and building carcasses, we can take on the workshop stages for you.

What we offer:
- Panel cutting on a sliding table panel saw
- ABS edge banding in 0.4, 1 and 2 mm, matched to your board décor
- Panel drilling for hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowels
- Cabinet assembly: base, wall, drawer and tall units
- Cut and edged boards ready to collect
- Workshop collection by arrangement, or delivery quoted per job

Trade and domestic orders welcome. Send us a clear cutting list with sizes, board décor and edges marked, and we'll come back with a priced quote.

Tap Learn more to see our trade services.
